title: Automatic Feed Band Saws — Value-Line CNC Bandsaws | NovoTech
meta_description: Value-line automatic feed band saws: BS300x370 roller-feed, BS-460GB swivel-head miter saw with 20 ft stand, BS-650G scissor-type NC saw and the BS-5040 single-column saw.
intro: Automatic saws that feed, clamp, cut and count by themselves — roller feeders on the compact BS300x370, the swivel-head BS-460GB that miters to both sides, the scissor-type BS-650G with NC feeding and 60° miters and a hydraulic shuttle vise on the single-column BS-5040; the CNC double column BS-500G, 500GT and 850G are on the double-column page. Value-line pricing with CSA-approved panels, a 1-year warranty and support from Mississauga, ON, Canada. For buyers searching for an automatic metal cutting bandsaw, a CNC band saw machine or an industrial horizontal band saw for metal with automatic feeding, these are the models NovoTech sells and supports in Canada.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoTech automatic band saws

faq.q: Roller feed or shuttle vise — which is better?
faq.a: Roller feed (BS300x370) is simple and fast for bar and tube in straight cuts. A shuttle vise (BS-5040, BS-460GB) grips the bar and moves it a set distance per stroke, which is more accurate and handles bundles; the CNC saws (BS-500G to BS-850G) position the feeder with a servo motor for the best repeatability.
The BS300x370H (0°–60° miter head), the BS-460GB (bow swivels both sides) and the scissor-type BS-650G (automatic swivel to 60° right).

faq.q: Do automatic saws need a roller table?
faq.a: The BS-460GB ships with a 20 ft material stand; for the other models a roller conveyor is optional and strongly recommended for bars longer than about 6 ft.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
